description: Use first for the entire requested task. Before broad task discovery, source edits, global verification, a user-task continuation, or a summary, create or read `workflow/data-to-d3-board.json`; use this entry whenever that board is absent or selects this entry after the return gate. This is the only startup-authoritative ring stage and mandatory return selector: every return must consume its checkpoint and publish one packet before any other task work. Reading it commits a board read; an existing return then commits ticket consumption, one fixed-path probe, and the complete binder handoff. The persistent board forbids cleanup and final response.
